title: Resident Cancellation of an Entrance Fee Agreement Before Occupancy
content:
A cancellation of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy is signed by the resident, or by a representative holding a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or guardianship authority, after the rescission period has ended and while the agreement is still reserved; signing it cancels the agreement and retains the processing fee from the money paid.

This entry governs a resident's request to cancel a reserved agreement once the rescission period of the campus has run out. The representative's authority is the one recorded on the customer profile.

## Business effect of the signature

| Item | After signing |
|---|---|
| Cancellation request awaiting the resident's signature | Marked signed |
| Agreement status | Cancelled, with the signing day as its termination date |
| Cancellation reason on the agreement | Resident's cancellation before occupancy |
| Refund payee on the agreement | The resident |
| Agreement ledger | One processing fee entry for the amount retained |
| Refundable balance | Lower by the processing fee |

## How the signature is taken

The signature is the customer's own action, through the tool `sign_pre_occupancy_cancellation_25852637`. The agent unlocks it and hands it over to the customer themselves, who signs electronically; the agent does not sign on the customer's behalf. The tool enters the processing fee exactly as given and checks no status, timing or eligibility of its own.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the resident who holds the agreement, read from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `entrance_agreement_id` | Reference number of the Entrance Fee Agreement being cancelled, read from the entrance fee agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `entrance_request_id` | Reference number of the pre-occupancy cancellation request awaiting the customer's signature on that agreement, read from the entrance fee request lookup | Identifier |
| `processing_fee` | The processing fee retained on this cancellation | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, entered rounded half up to the cent |

## Receipt

On success the receipt returns: `status` ("signed"); `customer_id`; `entrance_agreement_id` (now cancelled); `entrance_request_id` (now signed); `entrance_entry_id` (reference number of the processing fee retention entry); `processing_fee` (USD, 2 decimal places); `refundable_balance` (after the retention, USD, 2 decimal places); `termination_date` (the cancellation date, YYYY-MM-DD). The agreement then shows as cancelled with the termination reason `pre_occupancy_cancellation`, and the customer can see the processing fee retained.

## Points of judgement

| Agreement and timing | This entry |
|---|---|
| Reserved, rescission period ended | Applies |
| Reserved, still within the rescission period | Does not apply; the right of rescission governs |
| Occupied, cancelled, rescinded or closed | Does not apply |
